welcomeTitle:
A little world
of my own.
welcomeIntro: This is where my work, writing, and wandering meet. Come in, take the bike, and find a thought worth keeping.
workIntro: Financial tools, a book about Kenya, a game for the joy of it. A few things I’ve been building.
travelIntro: There’s more country beyond the garden. Walk to a vehicle, press E to get in, and choose a different pace. On a phone, use the thumbstick and the on-screen controls.
guideIntro: I’m Kijazo. I’ll be walking with you.
guideDescription: Every idea here is something Mathenge keeps tending. Some are seeds. Some are beginning to bud. A few have become evergreen. Meet the people along the paths, or take a vehicle out into the wider world.
